content.text: I've updated Tomcat to 5.0.30 in dev-147349. However, I'm thinking we should update Tomcat to the 5.5.x series, as 5.0.x no longer gets security updates:
I've gone ahead and updated Tomcat to 5.5.26 in dev-147349
Trunk should be updated as well (currently 5.5.23)
Issue 29521: No destroy methods called on service shutdown
This is fixed in 5.0.29 and later. We should update the bundled Tomcat (5.0.28) to the latest (currently 5.0.30).
